API docs by Redocly

CT Life REST API (1.0.0-rc1)

Download OpenAPI specification:

URL: https://github.com/devIykee/ct-life-backend License: MIT

REST v1 for the CT Life backend. Every endpoint is keyed by x-phase (1-6) and lists the error codes it can return, the auth policy, the idempotency contract, the headers it reads, and at least one example response.

The contract is the source of truth; the Unity client consumes it. Breaking changes bump the major version; additive changes bump the minor version and are recorded in contract/CHANGELOG.md.

All money is bigint cents (field names end in Cents) or string base units (token amounts). Times are ISO-8601 UTC for REST, epoch milliseconds for realtime. The week runs Mon 00:00 to Sun 23:59:59 UTC.

auth

Sign In With Solana, JWT, refresh, JWKS. Phases 1+.

Issue a SIWS challenge (nonce + SIWS message fields).

Returns a single-use nonce (5 min) and the SIWS message fields. The client builds sign_in_payload for the wallet, signs it, and posts the result to POST /auth/verify. Anonymous.

Verify a SIWS signature and issue a JWT pair.

Verifies the Ed25519 signature against the nonce, looks up the Seeker Genesis Token on mainnet via Helius, upserts the user, and returns { accessToken, refreshToken, user }. Anonymous.

Reserve one generation job against a verified likeness purchase.

Requires a server-verified dedicated purchase and verified owned private upload. Server derives mode from the approved model registry. No image URL, payment claim, provider key or user ID is accepted. The current production composition returns 503 and never uploads, charges or submits generation. Durable per-owner idempotency outlives the generic response cache; each entitlement can create only one job.

Normalize one consented photo into private, expiring storage.

Authenticated before buffering. The default composition returns 503 before decoding or storing photos. When explicitly configured, accepts PNG/JPEG bytes only (8 MiB maximum), decodes and strips metadata, and stores a normalized JPEG under an opaque private key. One active photo per owner. Identical retries replay the original upload; changed bytes with the same key are rejected.

Item keys the player owns that unlock something in the game.

The first key is vehicle.hovercar, the scarce right-to-drive pass for the roadstar vehicle kind (the hovercar). It is granted while the player's wallet holds an asset in the HOVERCAR_COLLECTION Metaplex Core collection (checked through Helius DAS on this call, at most once a minute) or by an ops grant, and revoked when the asset leaves the wallet. Game Cash never grants it. Without it, the vehicles room refuses a roadstar lease with NOT_ENTITLED.

Lease a home.

Debits the first week of rent and takes a free unit (door) of the home's tier. Tiers: parents_basement is basement, hacker_house and studio are flat, penthouse and marina_villa are penthouse. A tier with no units in contract/ids/home_units.json leases without a door (unitId null). Leasing a kind you already live in returns that home.

Repay debt from Cash.

Moves amountCents from Cash onto debt in one ledger transaction (loan_repay on both accounts). An amount above the outstanding debt is capped to it; repaidCents is what was actually paid. A replayed Idempotency-Key never pays twice.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
header Parameters
Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUIDv4 generated by the client. The server dedupes for 24 h and replays the first response and status. Same key with a different body hash returns VALIDATION_FAILED. Concurrent requests with the same key are serialized.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
amountCents
required
integer >= 1

My Cash history, newest first.

The Cash side of the ledger. kind is the ledger reason code (topup, shift_pay, gig_pay, rent, tip, tip_out, trade_buy, trade_sell, perp_margin, perp_close, prediction, prediction_payout, business_pay, loan_repay, ...); treat unknown kinds as generic and show label. Zero-amount rows are omitted. Pass next back as before for the next page; next is null on the last page.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
before
string^[0-9]+$
limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]

RTC tokens, spaces, free video calls, creator profile, paid calls. Phase 3+.

Mint a LiveKit access token.

Returns a token scoped to the room {kind}:{id}; id may be bare or carry its own single {kind}: prefix (Space ids are space:<uuid>), and a prefix of another kind is rejected. Grants are server-derived: for a Space, canPublish is true only for the host and promoted speakers, everyone else joins subscribe-only, and an ended, missing or blocked Space mints nothing (403/404). Space tokens last 10 minutes so each new token re-checks the role. Client permission flags are ignored.

bearerAuth

Book an ad slot (builds the payment intent).

Reserves the slot's next free window for an owned, unused upload and returns a server-priced USDC intent. The booking stays awaiting_payment until the payment is verified on chain, then moves to pending_review; only an admin approval makes it live. Unpaid holds expire with their intent and free the window.
